description: This file contains compatibility functions for the FreeType project, providing wrappers around stream operations such as open, seek, read, skip, extract, and release frames.

methods.name: FT_New_Memory_Stream
methods.description: Creates a new memory stream from a base pointer and size.

methods.name: FT_Seek_Stream
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the stream.

methods.name: FT_Skip_Stream
methods.description: Skips a certain number of bytes in the stream.

methods.name: FT_Read_Stream
methods.description: Reads data from the stream into a buffer.

methods.name: FT_Read_Stream_At
methods.description: Reads data from a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: FT_Extract_Frame
methods.description: Extracts a frame of data from the stream.

methods.name: FT_Access_Frame
methods.description: Accesses a frame in the stream.

methods.name: FT_Forget_Frame
methods.description: Exits the current frame in the stream.
